description: Xquik Twitter API profile with SDK, Skill, MCP, docs, and package links.
rules: Use README.md and profile/README.md as public indexes for Xquik SDK, skill, docs, and MCP links.

Codex CLI 0.147.0 and newer accept Xquik OAuth issuer validation. Older releases may report Authorization server response missing required issuer: expected https://xquik.com. Upgrade Codex, or set XQUIK_API_KEY and bearer_token_env_var = "XQUIK_API_KEY" in Codex TOML. See https://docs.xquik.com/guides/troubleshooting#codex-oauth-issuer-validation-error.
Use SECURITY.md and SUPPORT.md for public vulnerability and support reporting guidance.
Verify API behavior against xquik source, OpenAPI, generated SDK maps, or public registry metadata before changing claims.
Do not include API keys, private routing details, credentials, or unsupported package-health claims.
